build_cer_metric: build a CER metric instance using evaluate.load to compute character error ratio for ASR evaluation
compute_cer_score: compute the character error ratio score between predictions and references lists
compute_cer_concatenate: compute CER score with concatenate_texts=True to concatenate sentences before evaluation
get_cer_metric_info: get the CER metric metadata including description, citation, and input features schema
create_cer_transform: create a jiwer transform pipeline that removes multiple spaces, strips text, and reduces to character list
